mapper.insert: insert into orders (order_no, user_id, total_price, status, time, goods_name, address) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{time}, #{goodsName}, #{address})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = '已完成', finish_time = NOW() WHERE status = '已签收' AND receipt_time IS NOT NULL AND receipt_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
mapper.select:
select orders.*, user.name as userName, user.username as userAccount from orders left join user on orders.user_id = user.id
and orders.user_id = #{userId} and orders.user_delete = 0
and orders.admin_delete = 0
and orders.status in ('退货待审核','待用户发货','待商家收货','已退款')
and orders.status = #{status}
and ( orders.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') or orders.goods_name like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') or exists (select 1 from order_item where order_item.order_id = orders.id and order_item.goods_name like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%')) )
order by orders.id desc
select sum(total_price) from orders where admin_delete = 0 and status = '已完成'
select status as name, count(*) as value from orders where admin_delete = 0 group by status
select * from orders where status = '待付款' and time < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
select sum(total_price) from orders where admin_delete = 0 and status = '已完成' and time like concat(curdate(), '%')
select count(*) from orders where admin_delete = 0 and status = '已完成' and time like concat(curdate(), '%')
